newsitem.title: USA: Prudential Investments names Anne Riney CFO.
newsitem.headline: Prudential Investments names Anne Riney CFO.

text.p: Prudential Investments said Monday it named Anne Riney to the position of chief financial officer.

As CFO, Riney replaces Mendel Melzer, who was named chief investment officer of Prudential Investments Mutual Funds and Annuities. The company said Riney will oversee financial and accounting operations for Prudential Investments, including financial administration of Prudential's proprietary mutual funds and annuities.
Riney, 44, most recently served as vice president and manager of strategic planning at Salomon Brothers.
